findings.title: Preserve the test logger's recorder in FromContext
findings.body: FromContext returns a fresh TestLogger with independent log storage. LoggerMiddleware now emits every request-completion log through logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), so injecting a TestLogger records those calls on an inaccessible temporary instance while the supplied logger's InfoLogs remains empty. Tests inspecting the injected logger can no longer observe request logging. Return the existing fake, or share its recording state with the contextual logger.
